predecessors.name: Seljuks of Syria
predecessors.text: Damascus and its oasis, the Ghouta

successors.name: Zengid dynasty
successors.text: Damascus, annexed by Nur ad-Din in 1154

ledger.x: 1104: Toghtekin takes Damascus on Duqaq's death and founds the Burid line.

ledger.cp: holder not named by the page

ledger.x: 1122: the Fatimids sell Tyre to Toghtekin ('The Fatimids sold Tyre to him').
1124: the Franks capture Tyre on 7 July ('the Franks captured it on July 7, 1124').
Undated, placed at 1128: Hama is Burid by 1130, when Zengi 'seized Hama from him'; no page opened says when the Burids took it.
ledger.cp: holder not named by the page

ledger.x: 1138: Homs goes to Zengi as a dowry.
1139: Baalbek surrenders to Zengi on a promise of safe passage which 'he did not honor'; the territory was given to Najm al-Din Ayyub.
1154: the Burid line ends with the capture of Damascus by Nur ad-Din.

wars.name: Battle of Hab
wars.outcome: Toghtekin was defeated at the Battle of Hab on 14 August 1119 after joining Ilghazi's campaign; no change of holder for Damascus.

wars.name: Battle of Azaz
wars.outcome: Toghtekin and al-Bursuqi were defeated on 11 June 1125; Baldwin II's invasion of January 1126 was repelled and a late-1126 invasion of Antioch with Bursuqi achieved nothing.

wars.name: Zengi against Damascus and its dependencies
wars.outcome: Zengi seized Hama (1130), besieged Damascus in 1135 without success, received Homs as a dowry (May 1138), took Baalbek (1139) and besieged Damascus again in 1139-1140; Damascus allied with Jerusalem against him.

wars.name: Siege of Damascus (Second Crusade)
wars.outcome: The Burids prevented the Second Crusade from taking Damascus; 'the crusader siege collapsed after only four days' (Nur ad-Din page).

wars.name: Nur ad-Din's annexation of Damascus
wars.outcome: Nur ad-Din took Damascus with the help of its population and ended the Burid line.

certainty.note: A city emirate: Damascus and its oasis, with Homs, Baalbek, Hama and Tyre as holdings round named towns; no frontier on any page opened.
